distribution_scope: International internal TestFlight beta; no public App Store release requested
app_description: Native Swift Bitcoin Lightning research wallet, tested using regtest coins. Uses publicly documented AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, ChaCha20, HMAC/SHA-256, secp256k1 ECDH, ECDSA and Schnorr. CryptoKit provides the Apple cryptography; the app also includes libsecp256k1 and a Swift implementation of the standard ChaCha20 stream used by published BOLT 4 onion routing. This release is an international internal TestFlight beta, with no public App Store release requested.
